name: Nunavut Critical Minerals Partnership Program
description: Federal government opens Arctic-focused critical minerals partnerships supporting Nunavut iron ore and gold project development.

statusHistory.detail: While no specific updates for a 'Nunavut Critical Minerals Partnership Program project in Iqaluit' were found, Nunavut has actively participated in broader critical minerals initiatives. On January 25, 2026, Nunavut signed an MOU with other western and northern regions to collaborate on a critical minerals strategy. Additionally, the federal government announced over $3.6 billion in new programs and investments to unlock Canada's critical minerals advantage, including the launch of the $1.5 billion First and Last Mile Fund and the upcoming $2 billion Critical Minerals Sovereign Fund, which are intended to support critical minerals projects and infrastructure across Canada, including in the North.
statusHistory.note: Nunavut, along with other western and northern regions, signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on January 25, 2026, to develop a shared critical minerals strategy. The federal government also launched the $1.5 billion First and Last Mile Fund and announced the upcoming $2 billion Critical Minerals Sovereign Fund, which could support critical minerals infrastructure in Nunavut.
